verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page claims it can "manage expenses and issue reimbursements" and offers receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses. Its API covers manual expenses and repayments, which supports the core of submitting an out-of-pocket expense and being reimbursed. The evidence is thin, marketing-level claims only, and says nothing about payout method, speed or status tracking. Missing for 10: direct-deposit payout, reimbursement timing (paid in days), end-to-end status tracking from submission to payout, employee-facing submission flow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
